Everything listens on `127.0.0.1` only, so other devices on your network cannot open Moneo. Keep `.env` private: it holds the database password and the keys that sign the owner in.

## AI

Settings → **AI access** offers two equal options, and you choose which one pays:

- **ChatGPT plan**: click **Sign in with ChatGPT** and allow plan usage. Requests count toward your Go, Plus or Pro plan's limits.
- **OpenAI API key**: set `OPENAI_API_KEY` in `.env` and restart Moneo. Usage is billed to that key.

Voice calls and dictation need the API key, because ChatGPT plan usage doesn't support audio. Models are chosen per agent under Settings → AI and your data; IDs with a `/` (for example `vendor/model`) go to OpenRouter and need `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.

## Background jobs

While Moneo runs, it checks hourly for scheduled summaries, review recovery, bank sync and Scalable Capital sync. Each sync runs about once a day, and anything missed while the computer was off runs shortly after Moneo starts.

## Scalable Capital (optional)

First turn on access in Scalable on the web under Profile → Security → Agentic Investing (read-only is enough). Then Settings → **Connect Scalable Capital** opens Scalable's login (with 2FA in the Scalable app). Moneo then reads your holdings, totals and cash daily as wealth records. It uses Scalable's official read-only MCP server and needs no keys.

## Connect your bank (optional)

Moneo can sync booked transactions and balances from EU banks (for example Revolut and Commerzbank) through [Enable Banking](https://enablebanking.com). Its restricted mode is free for personal use and covers the accounts you link yourself. Each sync is written as an ordinary import, so it shows in import history and can be reviewed and undone.

1. Sign up at the [Enable Banking control panel](https://enablebanking.com/cp/) and create an application in the **Production** environment. A new production app runs in restricted mode: free, and limited to the accounts you link yourself.
2. Fill in the application form:
   - Redirect URL: `https://localhost:3443/api/bank/callback`
   - Privacy policy URL: `https://indkhan.github.io/Moneo/privacy.html`
   - Terms of service URL: `https://indkhan.github.io/Moneo/terms.html`
3. Let the control panel generate the key pair and keep the downloaded private key (`<application-id>.pem`).
4. In the control panel, link your own accounts to the application. Only linked accounts can be synced.
5. Add to `.env`, then restart Moneo:
   - `ENABLE_BANKING_APP_ID`: the application ID
   - `ENABLE_BANKING_PRIVATE_KEY`: the PEM contents (one line with literal `\n` is fine)
6. Use **Import → Connected banks → Choose a bank → Connect bank**.

Consent usually lasts up to 180 days, depending on the bank, and a reconnect banner appears 7 days before it ends. PSD2 allows about 4 background fetches a day per bank; Moneo syncs about once a day, and **Sync now** runs with you present, so it doesn't count. Pending transactions are not synced.

Enable Banking only accepts `https://` return addresses, so after you approve access the bank sends you to `https://localhost:3443`. Moneo answers there with a certificate `npm run setup` made and trusted on this computer only (using [mkcert](https://github.com/FiloSottile/mkcert); the first run may ask you to allow it), and passes you straight back to Moneo.

content.text:
Your `.env` already has an OpenAI API key and Enable Banking credentials, so AI and bank sync should work as soon as you open Moneo. There's no sign-up or login: it signs you in by itself.

**1. Open Moneo**
Go to http://localhost:3000.

**2. Check AI access**
- Go to Settings → **AI access**. The OpenAI API key from `.env` is already set up there.
- If you'd rather pay with your ChatGPT plan, click **Sign in with ChatGPT** instead. Voice calls and dictation still need the API key.
- Under Settings → **AI and your data** you choose a model for each agent. Pick models without a `/` in the name. Names with a `/` go through OpenRouter, and my notes say your OpenRouter credit ran out on 2026-10-27.

**3. Connect your bank (optional)**
- Go to **Import → Connected banks → Choose a bank → Connect bank**.
- You can only sync accounts you've linked to your app in the Enable Banking control panel (https://enablebanking.com/cp/). Link them there first if you haven't.
- After you approve at your bank, it sends you back through `https://localhost:3443`. If your browser warns about the certificate, allow it once.
- Later, **Sync now** fetches new transactions right away. Moneo also syncs about once a day by itself.

**4. Or import statements (no bank needed)**
On **Import**, upload a `.csv` or `.xlsx` statement. Every import can be reviewed and undone.

**5. Connect Scalable Capital (optional)**
- On the Scalable website, go to Profile → Security → **Agentic Investing** and turn on access. Read-only is enough.
- In Moneo, go to Settings → **Connect Scalable Capital**, log in, and approve the 2FA in the Scalable app.
- Moneo then reads your holdings and cash once a day.

**6. Use it**
Check your accounts and wealth under **Money**, plan spending under **Plan**, and ask questions in chat or on a voice call.

**Day to day**
- **Starting again:** open Docker Desktop, then run `npm start` in `C:\codebases\Moneo`.
- **After a `git pull`:** run `npm run setup`, then `npm run build && npm start`.
- **Stopping:** stop the `npm start` process. The database keeps running until you run `docker compose stop`.
- **Never run `docker compose down -v`:** it deletes all your data.

content.text:
You can now enter your OpenAI, OpenRouter and Enable Banking keys in the app, and they stay saved in the database. Moneo is running again at http://localhost:3000 with these changes. Tests, lint and build pass. All of this is on branch `t3/in-app-keys` in 7 commits; nothing is pushed and no PR is open.

**Why the bank connection failed:** Enable Banking rejected Moneo's return address (`REDIRECT_URI_NOT_ALLOWED`). The code can't fix this; you have to change your Enable Banking application:
1. Open https://enablebanking.com/cp/ and go to your application.
2. Add the Redirect URL `https://localhost:3443/api/bank/callback` and save.
3. Click **Connect bank** in Moneo again.

Moneo now shows that same instruction when this error happens, instead of the generic "could not be started".

**Where you enter keys:**
- **Settings → AI access:**
  - You can save an OpenAI key, an OpenRouter key, or both. Each is checked with a free call before it's saved, shown by its last 4 characters, and can be replaced or removed.
  - With only an OpenRouter key, a note stays visible: "That's fine, but voice calls and dictation need an OpenAI API key." The mic and Call buttons explain this instead of failing, and chat runs through OpenRouter.
  - "Sign in with ChatGPT" is unchanged.
- **Import → Connected banks:** if no bank keys are saved, there's a form for the App ID and private key (paste it or upload the `.pem`). It has copy buttons for the redirect, privacy and terms addresses.

**About `.env`:**
- **Still needed:** it can't go away completely. It holds the database password and sign-in keys that Docker needs before Moneo starts. `npm run setup` writes it, and you never have to open it.
- **Your existing keys:** the three in your current `.env` keep working until you save keys in the app. A key saved in the app always wins.
- **Removing them:** once you've saved your keys in the app, you can delete those lines from `.env`.

**Also:**
- "Reset all data" keeps your saved keys.
- Two tests timed out during the full test run; both pass when run on their own.
- Three follow-ups went to `BACKLOG.md`:
  - a "move key from `.env` to the app" button
  - a warning about the redirect address when you save bank keys
  - updating the voice-check script, which still reads its key from `.env`

I applied the new migration (`npm run setup`) and restarted the server.
